title: 写邮件 Write an Email
intro: 限时约 7 分钟。读情景，用完整句子写一封达成沟通目的的邮件。官方 0–5 评分。

template.name: 邮件万能框架（照这个顺序写，band 4 稳）
frame: ① 称呼：Dear [姓名/头衔], （正式）｜ Hi [姓名], （半正式）
② 来意 1 句：I am writing to ... / I am reaching out about ...
③ 情况+影响 1–2 句：Recently, ... As a result, ...（说清为什么写、对你有什么影响）
④ 方案/请求 1–2 句：I would like to suggest ... / Would it be possible to ...?（对应题目每个 bullet）
⑤ 礼貌收尾：Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to your reply.
⑥ 落款：Best regards, / Sincerely, + [你的名字]
phrases: I am writing to ask about / to request / to let you know that ...
As a result, I have been unable to ...
I would like to suggest that ... / Would it be possible to ...?
I would really appreciate it if you could ...
Please let me know if there is anything else you need from me.
Thank you for your understanding. I look forward to hearing from you.
template.tips: 对齐题目的每个 bullet 各写 1 句，别漏点；语气礼貌（这科考 social conventions / 语域）；6–10 句、120 词左右足够 band 4。

items.subject: Fundraising event for the children's hospital
items.scenario: A local community organization is planning a fundraising event for a local children's hospital. You want to contact Ms. Lopez to discuss the event and possible support. Write as much as you can, in complete sentences.
bullets: Describe the purpose of the fundraising event.
Explain why you think the activity will be successful.
Suggest a time to meet and discuss the plans in more detail.

options: The purpose of the event is to raise money for new medical equipment at the children's hospital.
We are organizing this event to support young patients and their families.
All the funds we raise will go toward improving care for sick children.
I believe the event will be successful because many local businesses have already offered to help.
A similar event last year attracted a large crowd, so we expect a strong turnout again.
With good publicity and community support, I am confident that we will reach our goal.
Would you be available to meet next Wednesday afternoon to discuss the plans in more detail?
I would like to arrange a short meeting at your convenience, perhaps early next week.
Please let me know a time that works for you, and I will make myself available.

models.label: 范文 A · 简洁稳妥版（band 4）
models.text:
Dear Ms. Lopez,

I am writing to tell you about a fundraising event that our community organization is planning for the local children's hospital. The purpose of the event is to raise money for new medical equipment and to help families who cannot afford treatment.

I believe the activity will be successful because many local businesses have already offered to help, and a similar event last year attracted a large crowd. With good advertising, I am confident that even more people will take part this time.

I would love to discuss the plans with you in more detail. Would you be available to meet next Wednesday afternoon, around 3 p.m.? Please let me know if another time works better for you.

Thank you for your time and support.

Best regards,
Fish

models.label: 范文 B · 进阶丰富版（band 5）
models.text:
Dear Ms. Lopez,

I hope this email finds you well. I am reaching out on behalf of our community organization, which is planning a fundraising event to support the local children's hospital. The main purpose of the event is to raise funds for new medical equipment and to help cover treatment costs for families in need.

I am confident that the event will be a success for several reasons. First, a number of local shops and restaurants have already agreed to donate prizes and refreshments. Second, a similar event we held last spring drew more than two hundred visitors, so we already have an enthusiastic community behind us. With your support, I believe we can reach an even wider audience.

I would very much appreciate the chance to discuss the details with you in person. Would you be available to meet sometime next week, for example on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon? Please let me know what suits you best.

Thank you very much for considering our request. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
Fish

items.subject: Slow Wi-Fi in the dormitory
items.scenario: For the past week, the Wi-Fi in your dormitory has been very slow, and it often disconnects during online classes. Several of your classmates have the same problem.
bullets: Describe the Wi-Fi problem and how it affects you.
Mention that others are affected too.
Politely ask the IT office to fix it soon.

items.subject: Switching my workshop session
items.scenario: You signed up for a campus resume workshop on Friday afternoon, but a required class was just rescheduled to the same time, so you can no longer attend.
bullets: Explain why you can no longer attend Friday's session.
Ask whether you can switch to another session.
Ask to receive the materials if no other session is available.

items.subject: Textbook is out of stock
items.scenario: The required textbook for your professor's course is sold out at the campus bookstore, and the next shipment will not arrive for three weeks. The first assignment is due next week.
bullets: Let the professor know the textbook is unavailable.
Explain your concern about the upcoming assignment.
Ask if there is a scan or another way to access the first chapter.

items.subject: Joining your study group
items.scenario: You saw a notice about a weekly study group for a statistics course, organized by a classmate named Sam. You would like to join.
bullets: Say where you saw the notice and that you want to join.
Ask when and where the group meets.
Offer to help by sharing your practice problems.

items.subject: Requesting a room repair
items.scenario: The heater in your dormitory room has stopped working, and the weather is getting cold. You have already reported it once by phone but no one has come.
bullets: Describe the problem and that it was already reported once.
Explain how it is affecting you.
Ask for a specific time when someone can come to fix it.
